name: Colossus Hammer
oracle_text:
Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.
Equip {8} ({8}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)
blocked_sentences: Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.

needs.what: a static that removes a named keyword from the affected permanents in layer 6 in timestamp order (613.7), so a grant of that keyword with a later timestamp (Jump, an anthem cast afterwards, a flying counter) gives it back: 'Equipped creature ... loses flying' with affects {attached: true}, distinct from the 'can't have or gain' prohibition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The lose_keyword static is implemented in characteristics.py as a standing 'can't have or gain' prohibition applied after every adder (layer 2 grants, keyword counters, until-end-of-turn grants, granted_keywords), so it would stop a later Jump or flying grant from giving the equipped creature flying; the printed 'loses flying' is a plain one-time removal that later-timestamped grants override. lose_all_abilities is far too broad. The +10/+10 half (buff) and Equip {8} are expressible.
